notes.text: When Hannah protested to Eli that she was not a "daughter of Belial" she meant a "worthless or profane person." Belial means "worthless, someone of evil affiliation." It is capitalized by the English translators as if it were a title for Satan and is sometimes so used in later books of the Old Testament (see Rasmussen, Introduction to the Old Testament, 1:161).
